description: This Java class 'Reflect' provides utility methods for reflection operations such as retrieving class fields, checking class hierarchies, and inspecting annotations. It is part of the 'org.openmrs.util' package and is used to facilitate introspection of Java objects and classes within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: Reflect
classes.description: Utility class offering reflection-related functionalities such as examining class fields, checking type hierarchies, and handling collection types within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: Reflect
methods.description: Constructor that sets the target class for reflection operations, expects a non-null Class object.

methods.name: isCollection
methods.description: Checks if a given Class or Object instance is a Collection.

methods.name: getAllFields
methods.description: Retrieves all fields, including private and inherited, from a specified class and its superclasses.

methods.name: isAnnotationPresent
methods.description: Determines if a specified annotation is present on a given field of a class.

methods.name: isSuperClass
methods.description: Checks if a given class or type is a subclass or accessible from the configured parameterized class.

methods.name: isCollectionField
methods.description: Verifies whether a field is a collection with elements of a type compatible with the configured class.

methods.name: getInheritedFields
methods.description: Returns fields declared in a subclass that are also part of the parameterized class hierarchy.

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks if a given field is declared in the parameterized class or its subclasses.
